issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement labels the class as "Course" while the rest of the exercise (text, template, and solution) refer to the class as "Lecture". This discrepancy between the class name in the UML and the actual class students must implement is likely to confuse learners about which class to create/modify.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the UML class from "Course" to "Lecture" in problem_statement.md so the diagram matches the class name used throughout the text, template, and solution. Alternatively, if the intent was to use the name Course, update the template and solution to use Course consistently. Ensure the UML and all textual references use the same class name.
